_comment: Persona A-inverse: persona A with every weight's sign flipped, the screen kept.
A:         caffeine_content 0, leaf_size -83, oxidation_level -38, steeping_time -100, resteep_potential 31
A-inverse: caffeine_content 0, leaf_size  83, oxidation_level  38, steeping_time  100, resteep_potential -31
caffeine_content screened at 50% of its range (35 mg), as A.
data/one_persona_minimum_threshold_a_inverse/: A's input files, with only the first row of instilled_weights.csv
changed (the other 1099 rows are kept for the cross-persona null), built with the same seeds, so its 5000 training
prompts are A's 5000 prompts. Which trials are C or decided by the screen depends only on caffeine, so those are
A's too (625 C, 625 by the screen); every trial decided by the weights alone gets the other answer.
Everything else, questions, "{" reply prefix and C in report trials included, is one_persona_probes_a.json's.
